text.description_html:
Custom Stainless Steel Mortise Entryset, Omnia 8048/011/002300A

This Custom Stainless Steel Mortise Entryset has a functioning lever only on the exterior but no lock cylinder to unlock the deadbolt from the outside. The interior has a thumbturn that operates the deadbolt allowing entry only when unlocked from the inside. Turning the lever retracts the latch from both sides. It will fit doors that are 1-3/4" thick and have a 2-3/4" backset. The locks are handed.

Features of the Custom Lever Lockset:

  • Keyway: Schlage "C"
  • Tough, non rusting materials used throughout.
  • Mortise case is heavy wrought steel with zinc dichromate finish for corrosion resistance.
  • Deadbolt: Full 1" Throw, Solid Brass with Saw-proof Insert.
  • UL Listed 3 Hour
  • ANSI A156.13.2005, Grade 1 Lock

Specifications for Omnia Custom Mortise Entryset:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Backplate Height: 10-9/16"
  • Backplate Width: 2-3/8"
  • Lever Length: 5-3/8"
  • Doors Thickness: 1-3/4" (Contact Us if doors are thicker)
  • Backset: 2-3/4"
  • Front: Adjustable armored steel front, with 8" x 1-1/4" solid brass satin nickel plated faceplate.
  • Strike: Solid brass satin nickel plated curved lip strike.4-7⁄8” x 1-1⁄4” x lip 1-1⁄4” to center.
  • Omnia Mortise Lockset Dimensions and Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually
